``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
services:
  omni-tools:
    image: iib0011/omni-tools:latest@sha256:9a94e6ebc8dada2c7a5607b232214307e6f903a7747878602281ecdb79ced851
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    ports:
      - 8090:80
    deploy:
      labels:  # (1)!
        - homepage.group=Tools
        - homepage.name=omni-tools
        - homepage.icon=omni-tools.png
        - homepage.href=http://192.168.1.45:8090
        - homepage.description=File and text tools in the browser
      mode: replicated
      replicas: 1
```

1.  labels for the tile on the [homepage dashboard](../monitoring/homepage.md). they go under
    `deploy.labels` because homepage reads the swarm's service specs, and container labels aren't in them.
